verdict.rationale: Unleash ships Unleash Edge, a first-party caching and relay layer that SDKs connect to with backend tokens. The docs say targeting data such as user IDs, emails or IPs is processed inside the Edge node and never sent upstream, which means flag evaluation happens at the edge/relay layer. Missing for 10: evidence of deployment geographically close to users or multi-region placement, CDN-worker support, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Edge evaluation.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users

citations.quote: Unleash Enterprise Edge is a lightweight caching layer designed to improve scalability, performance, and resilience.
user data (PII) used for targeting rules (like user IDs, emails, or IPs) is processed within the Edge node and never sent to the Unleash Cloud or your upstream instance
functioning as a read replica that can handle thousands of connected SDKs without increasing the read load on your primary Unleash instance
Backend tokens for connecting backend SDKs or Unleash Edge to Unleash.
